name: boxbox
description: Guides writing and refactoring TypeScript and Python, with syntax and tabular checks for TypeScript, Python, JSON and YAML and human-approved whitespace alignment.

interface.shortDescription: Write, refactor and align code for tabular readability
interface.longDescription: Guides agent-owned TypeScript and Python writing and refactoring; checks TypeScript, Python, JSON and YAML and aligns approved tables one file at a time. Unsupported structures remain unchanged. Structural changes require separate behavior verification.
